{{Quote|Wesa no like da Naboo. Da Naboo tink day so smarty. Day tink day brains so big.|[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Boss Nass]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Naboo''' (singular "Naboo"),<ref name="TPM" /> sometimes known as the '''Royal Naboo''',<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" /> They were not native to the world, but they became the dominant intelligent life-form there.<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Young-palpatine.jpg|thumb|left|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was arguably the most influential Naboo in history]]
The Naboo descended from the [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmalltian]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who fled a violent revolution on their planet. Led by [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]], they colonized [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and settled in the mountains and great grass plains around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> For a time, the stranded colonists lived as a nomadic tribe and wandered in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] in search of a site they could settle. They subsequently arrived at the [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], and they started a farming community on that land, equipped with wind turbines.<ref name="Crisis">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 3 caption}}</ref> Over time, other communities were founded, and they gradually evolved into [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="SoN" />

At first, the colonists clashed with the indigenous [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], a species of land-dwelling [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]]. After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of bloody conflicts between the two people, those who had renamed themselves "the Naboo" chose to reinvent their culture. They decided to place pacifism and rationalism above all other values, and elected a [[First Queen of Naboo|queen]] to govern themselves. The Naboo had changed from a group of greedy adventurers to a pacific society with a tradition of selecting their [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|rulers]] based on intelligence rather than might.<ref name="SoN" />

Around [[868 BBY]],<ref name="CoN">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Republic officials approached the descendants of the Grizmalltian colonists with an offer to join. Despite their current difficulties, the Naboo accepted. While they remained spatially isolated from the rest of Republic space, the Naboo soon began trading with other systems.<ref name="SoN" />

Cultural differences led to tension between the two peoples—but direct conflict was rare. Over time there was more conflict between the various Human settlements than between the Naboo and Gungans. The Gungans believed the Naboo to be "pompous cowards" while the Naboo believed the Gungans to be "barbarians." This attitude lasted until [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] united the Gungans and Naboo to fight the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

Naboo politics often involved large numbers of teenaged Naboo in government work, a result of the Naboo ideal of valuing inner purity and innocence over political ability. This often resulted in individuals receiving positions far beyond their own level of competence and being left vulnerable to manipulation, such as the case of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Amidala and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Culture==
[[File:Naboo2.jpg|thumb|The city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], capital of Naboo]]

===Overview===
[[File:DeejaPeakFarmers-CrisisOnNaboo.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Hologram/Legends|Holographic]] depiction of a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] community developing at [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]]]
Naboo was a sparsely inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]], shared by two intelligent species: the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="SoN" /> who immigrated from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]].<ref name="NEC" /> Due to Naboo's relative isolation from the rest of the galactic community, no other sapient species had settled on the planet by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], although ethnographers linked to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="SoN" /> correctly<ref name="TEA" /> predicted this scenario would likely change in the following decades, given the planet's attempt to increase interstellar commerce.<ref name="SoN" /> During Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia's]] reign, Naboo loosened immigration restrictions and accepted [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] refugees, which totaled 625 million beings.<ref name="refugees">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_1.html|Mid Rim Worlds Open Ports to Refugees}}</ref> By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="STAC date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> the long-distance travel company [[Naboo Spacelines]] was active.<ref name="STAC-J">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref> Indeed, given time, the number of offworlders on Naboo grew to up to 1% of the total planetary population.<ref name="TEA" />

The thinly scattered settlements on Naboo were mainly dedicated to ranching and mining, and concentrated in the main and southern landmasses. They were separated by large tracts of land, and the Naboo historically didn't shown much interest in the commercial development of these wilderness areas.<ref name="SoN" />

Artistic and intellectual pursuits were the main drive in Naboo society, while also embracing nonviolence and rationalism in dispute resolution, never resorting to physical aggression.<ref name="SoN" /> The Naboo were known for their love of peace, cordiality and warmth. Strangers would be met with smiles, bows and helpfulness by the planet's residents. The natives felt there was an art to living, and their cuisine, architecture and clothing all reflected this assumption.<ref name="LotJ:DoN">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> [[Xenosociology|Xenosociologists]] postulated that the Naboo emphasis on pacifism and art was a reflection of a cultural bias, instead of a genetic predisposition, since the Naboo were never completely shut off from the rest of the [[galactic community]] for enough time for them to evolve into a separate species.<ref name="SoN" /> Much like [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the planet Naboo prided itself on peace and diplomacy, and its capital Theed was a popular [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] destination due to its long, rich history and the fact that important figures in [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]] such as Padmé Amidala and Palpatine hailed from the planet.<ref name="ATSS">{{Disney|domain=go.com|url=star-tours-adventures/naboo|text=Naboo}}</ref>

Community service was mandatory for all citizens between the ages of 12 and 20.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

Privacy was very valuable to the Naboo.<ref name="LotJ:DoN" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the planet maintained no global registry of citizens, as people seemed to know each other through a system of clans and families. After Amidala's death, Naboo customs prevented questions on the fatherhood of her twins, and no medical reports were drafted.<ref name="LotJ:DoN" />

Both Gungan and Naboo cultures had a strong relationship with [[Water/Legends|water]], although the Nabooans believed that the restorative and meditative qualities of this element were best regarded from dry land, unlike the Gungans, who built their society underwater.<ref name="inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> Gungans revered nature and attempted to harmonize it with their civilization, while the Naboo followed a similar philosophy.<ref name="FFJarJar2014">{{FactFile2014|10|JAR 1-4|Jar Jar Binks}}</ref>

The city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] was considered a retreat for artists and intellectuals by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

===Interspecies relations===
{{Quote|For centuries the Naboosan have treated yousan like second-classed citizens. Nosa more!|[[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] to fellow Gungans|<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>}}
The Naboo were raised to think of the amphibious Gungans as barbarians.<ref name="NEGC" /> Gungans, in turn, were offended that many of the Naboo would think themselves superior to the natives.<ref name="FFJarJar2014" />

Both societies were greatly intertwined economically, if not politically.<ref name="crossI">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Traders on the fringes of Naboo towns carried on vital commerce between them and the native Gungans.<ref name="TPMV" />

After the Trade Federation invasion of the planet, Gungans and Naboo increased cooperation in defense policy. Both groups developed action plans to resist future possible sieges and exchanged technologies. The Gungans' shield expertise, allied with the Naboo power-generation technology, allowed for a global defense system that was capable of quickly repelling orbital bombardments and intrusive landings. This new defense policy received widespread support from the populace.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Language==
[[File:Naboo_mccaig.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Futhork alphabet]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Naboo possessed their own distinct language, although many of them also spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko's]] epic poem "[[Defense of Naboo/Legends|Defense of Naboo]]" was a notable example of a work written in the [[Naboo (language)|Naboo]].<ref name="DP" /> They also developed their own alphabet, known as [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]], a style of traditional, handwritten [[Writing/Legends|calligraphy]] which was derived from the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt|Royal Script]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. While Futhark was the official form, the reliance of all of its letters on ovals made it hard to read. This difficulty led to an adaptation to the more practical [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]].<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the art of writing in Futhork was still taught at schools,<ref name="Ryoo">{{DB|character|ryoonaberrie|Naberrie, Ryoona}}</ref> although even the farmers could write in both Futhork and [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] fluently.<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> In the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the use of the Futhork alphabet was already three and a half [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] old.<ref name="TWW" />

==Philosophy==
Naboo philosophy emphasized the concept of "peaceful existence," although this idea started to gradually erode during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="crossI" />

The planet had a significant percentage of acclaimed philosophers, as a result of an educational system that actively stimulated artistic and intellectual skills.<ref name="SoN" /> [[Naboo philosophers|Some of them]] eventually became so famous and important that they were immortalized as monumental statues on the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|forecourt]] of Theed Royal Palace and over the balustrade of the [[Theed Coliseum]]. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Naboo [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] was a notable philosopher from the planet.<ref name="TPMV" />

==Art==
Naboo culture was primarily focused on [[Art (COMPNOR)/Legends|art]] and learning, and by the time of the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet, it had gained a considerable reputation for having some of the most accomplished artists and philosophers in the galaxy.<ref name="SoN" /> Additionally, artisans, architects and urban planners were all valued highly in Naboo society.<ref name="TPMV" />

===Architecture===
With the reign of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]], the Naboo entered an era of unparalleled prosperity, which gave them the opportunity to focus on education and all kinds of art, including that of architecture. Along with urban planners and artisans, architects came to be highly regarded in the Naboo society, and one of the monarch's closests advisors bore the title of [[Chief Architect/Legends|Chief Architect]].<ref name="TPMV" />

====Underlying philosophy====
[[File:Theed_Palace_low_angle.png|thumb|250px|The [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|classical Naboo architecture]] was characterised by rounded rooflines and soft colors.]]
The Naboo thought of their [[City/Legends|cities]] as further adornments to their homeworld's landscape, which prompted them to preserve as much of the planet's natural beauty as possible.<ref name="SoN" /> From afar, a typical Naboo city looked like a sprawl of stone walls, peaked towers, gilded cupolas, and sculpted archways&mdash;the appearance of which acted as a counterpoint to the surrounding greenness.<ref name="TPMN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> The whole [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was considered to be the crown jewel of the [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|Naboo architecture]]. It had been designed to radiate outward from the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] while making sure that central edifice would always the dominate the skyline.<ref name="SoN" /> In the last decades of the Galactic Republic, the capital was noted for its harmonious unity of style, which was due to the extensive rebuilding it had gone through over time.<ref name="inside" /> The Naboo's permanent quest for architectural elegance was reflected even in the most practical buildings. For example, the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]] was noted for its regal appearance that was said to rival that of actual palaces elsewhere in the galaxy.<ref name="SoN" />

====Characteristics====
{{Quote|But I would feel better if I thought about the palace&mdash;the way it shimmers in the sunlight, the way the air always smells of flowers&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:Naboo_street.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Flowering vines and potted plants added vibrancy and scents to the sandstone walls.]]
The dominant architectural style, referred to as "classical Naboo style,"<ref name="TPMV" /> featured extensive use of porticoes, domed roofs,<ref name="SoN" /> and circular plans. Many important buildings, including the [[Theed University/Legends|Theed University]] and most of the Royal Palace's structure, were rotundas. Even the structures with a polygonal base were often topped by one or several circular domes,<ref name="inside" /> although flat roofs were not rare.<ref name="DP" /> In truth, some of the most squarish buildings, such as the [[Guido's Tower/Legends|Guido's Tower]] or the Palace's [[Turret Room/Legends|Turret Room]] were noted for belonging to a more ancient style.<ref name="inside" /> Other prominent example of the circular plan was the [[Theed Coliseum]], a large funnel-shaped sports stadium that stood on its own plaza,<ref name="ELAC">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref> or the grand hemispherical [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]].<ref name="AOC" /> Other common types of buildings included tiered towers supported by round-topped archways.<ref name="DP" />

The typical Naboo cupolas were made of verdigris, while the walls of the building themselves were made of polished, light brown to yellow [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]]. The streets and plazas were also paved with sandstone-like flags,<ref name="inside" /> which could be laid out in a circular pattern.<ref name="ELAC" /> Sometimes, in villages and smaller town, the roofs were reddish-brown clay tiles.<ref name="SW:GB" /> In the inside, the most prestigious buildings were walled with slabs of [[Marble/Legends|marble]] varying in color from gray to red.<ref name="TPM" /> In addition to the many [[Window/Legends|windows]] that doted most edifices,<ref name="inside" /> creating an atmosphere of serenity,<ref name="TPMV" /> flowering vines were allowed to grow freely on the walls.<ref name="TPMJN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref> Filigreed bridges spanned across the many tributaries of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] that flowed through the city.<ref name="DP" /> Fountains were also a common sight, forming a distant backdrop to the ambient noise.<ref name="TPMN" /> The modern Naboo architecture seamlessly blended all those historic design facets with such technologies as communication systems, automatic doors and area-specific climate control.<ref name="TPMV" /> Contrary to what could be seen on city-planets such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], they were very few towering [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]] on Naboo. The building's delicate color scheme and rounded rooftops gave them a very soft, comforting appearance.<ref name="AOCN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> On the whole, with its low, convex, and condensed appearance, the classic Naboo architecture was the very antithesis of the [[Neo-Classical]] style favored in the cities of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], where most buildings consisted of towering, angular and austere spires.<ref name="DP" />

===Music===
Naboo maintained the [[Theed Music Hall]], a theater where popular musical entertainment took place. The Hall contained a stage and a pit, from which specialized [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would come out and play music for the benefit of the audience.<ref name="ELAC" /> By the time of the Invasion of Naboo, [[Harp/Legends|harpist]] [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]] was the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] for the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]].<ref name="brandesDB">{{DB|character|helabrandes|Brandes, Hela}}</ref> Brandes would later join efforts with fellow musicians [[Bongiovi]], [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]] and [[Tofli Argala]] to persuade famous composer [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]] to come out of retirement for a charity [[Theed Palace Plaza concert|concert]]. The concert was held in the Theed [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] and sold out, with all profits being used to support children orphaned by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on both sides of the conflict.<ref name="slugt1">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

At least two Naboo natives played [[shudderup]]. A vagrant Jar Jar Binks annoyed other Gungans while playing the music in his youth,<ref name="NEGC" /> while it was also the style of the planet's singer and [[Quetarra|quetarrist]] [[Bongiovi]].<ref name="slugt1" />

===Literature===
The [[Royal Archives of Naboo]] was an institution on the planet that was known to record historical documents, such as the personal memoirs of former [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] [[Pars Varqom]] during the Invasion of Naboo and its aftermath. The archives had at least 2,453 volumes.<ref name="SaN">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>

The Naboo generally had good knowledge of poetry, as even the lowliest laborers could be seen debating the merits of one classical poet over another.<ref name="SoN" /> Omar Berenko, one such poet, wrote "Defense of Naboo," a poem considered by many to be disturbing yet imaginative.<ref name="DP" /><ref name="ITWSW:AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Galactic Emperor Palpatine, a Nabooan, was also a prolific writer on political topics, authoring books such as ''[[The Paths to Power]]'' ([[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]),<ref name="Inaugural Edition">''{{InsiderCite|79|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}''</ref> ''[[Absolute Power]]'' ([[19 BBY/Legends|19]]&ndash;[[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]), ''[[Book of Sith]]'' (19&ndash;18 BBY)<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and ''[[Principles of Power]]'' (c. [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]).<ref name="ShieldofLies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

===Visual arts===
[[File:PadmeBazaar-AoN.png|thumb|Padmé Amidala, as portrayed by a local Naboo artist]]
Some of the art hailing from Naboo took the form of paintings that exhibited a style consisting of short, thick strokes of paint on a canvas, aiming to capture the essence of the subject, rather than its details. Its object of study could be either astronomical objects such as [[Star/Legends|suns]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] or individuals. At least [[Unidentified Naboo artist|one painter]] based on an [[Abandoned Naboo castle|abandoned castle]] north of Theed employed this ensemble of techniques, around the final years of the Old Republic.<ref name="AON">{{StoryCite|story=The Artist of Naboo|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> In Theed itself, the [[Parnelli Museum of Art/Legends|Parnelli Museum of Art]] was home to objects of art.<ref name="inside" />

===Performing arts===
The [[Theed Coliseum]] and the [[Naboo Puppet Theater]] both provided performing arts spectacles in the capital.<ref name="ELAC" />

===Symbols===
{{Expandsect}}

==Lifestyle==
The Naboo saw their refined way of life as a birthright.<ref name="TPMV" />

In cosmetics, the Naboo were known to enjoy perfumes and fragrances, as evidenced by the existence of a [[Port Landien Perfumery|perfumery]] in the [[Beach/Legends|beach]] town of [[Port Landien]].<ref name="monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref>

===Cuisine===
Human Nabooans enjoyed [[Wine/Legends|wine]], and produced certain kinds of rare or prestigious beverages, such as the [[Tarul wine|Tarul]],<ref name="RCHC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> [[Blossom wine|Blossom]]<ref name="SWE19">[[Empire 19|''Empire'' 19]]</ref> and [[Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac/Legends|Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac]] wines.<ref name="Domaine name">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode215.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Senate Murders}}</ref> The Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac was famous enough to be favored by high-ranking officials of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic, such as [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] Padmé Amidala, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]].<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> Certain criminal groups such as the [[Mummers]] were also known to produce and trade illegal [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages and spices.<ref name="SWG" />

[[Shaak pot roast]], a dish based on roasted [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] meat, was also very popular on Naboo.<ref name="DexDining">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> In some special or formal occasions, the Naboo [[Five-blossom bread/Legends|five blossom bread]] was served.<ref name="SenateSpy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> For dessert, Theed was credited as the source of the [[plasma cloud]], a fusion of Gungan and Naboo cuisines created during the cultural mingling post-Invasion of Naboo. Plasma cloud recipes required carefully infusing the egg whites of the [[Pikobi/Legends|Pikobi]], a flightless avian native to Naboo, with [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] mined from the planet. When properly prepared, the resulting dish was considered light and refreshing.<ref name="FOO8">{{FactFile|131|FOO 7-8|Galactic Food and Drink}}</ref>

During wartime, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] would build large [[Animal nursery|animal nurseries]] and [[food processing center]]s, where collected food from [[Muja fruit/Legends|Muja fruit]] bushes, [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and hunted or raised animals such as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and [[Fish/Legends|fish]] would be processed.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Sports and hobbies===
Racing sports were popular on Naboo. The city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] hosted the [[Keren Street Race|Keren City Street Race]], which featured famous [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] of the likes of [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]].<ref name="SWG" /> After the planet's victory against the Trade Federation, the friendly [[Victory Races of Naboo]] were organized, and saw the participation of Naboo and Gungans alike.<ref name="YCAC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref> Naboo citizens also took up the fast-moving [[Odupiendo racing]], and the planet was known for its tracks.<ref name="TIP1">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref> Even though it was banned from most civilized [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="crossI" /><!-- p. 14 --> and extremely dangerous to Humans,<ref name="TIP1" /> [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] was practiced on Naboo, as evidenced by the [[Lianorm Raceway]], a 10.5 mile-long course set up on the planet.<ref name="RacerRush">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/racer-rush|text=Racer Rush|int=Racer Rush}}</ref>

The planet was also the origin of the aquatic [[Theed quoits/Legends|Theed quoits]], a game played on water with a palm-sized ball known as a [[quoit]]. It was said to have evolved from a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]] hunting technique. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was known to play Theed quoits.<ref name="revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> In 1 ABY, the [[Aerie Casino]] [[Aerie Casino opening|opening]] near Moenia was marked by a blood sport competition between various exotic animals pitted against each other. The eventual winner was a [[Lok/Legends|Lokian]] [[flit]], which defeated a [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[malkloc]] in the final match.<ref name="RuinsofDantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>

Children commonly played a game called [[Kaadu-and-aliens]] during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="CNI">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

===Fashion===
[[File:Naboo_clothing.png|thumb|Ordinary citizens displaying Naboo fashion around the time of Veruna's abdication]]
{{SeeAlso|Padmé Amidala's wardrobe}}
{{Quote|They are traditionalists—tonsorially as well as politically. The style of dress and facial adornments pay homage to the regalia of Queen Elsinore den Tasia of Grizmallt, who dispatched an expeditionary fleet of Humans to the planet some four thousand years ago, and to whom some Naboo claim to be able to trace an unbroken ancestry.|[[Larsh Hill]] on the Naboo|audio=Tonsorially.flac|<ref name="DP" />}}
On Naboo, clothing was often used a form of social communication. For instance, during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]], the citizens of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] made subtle use of Naboo [[Color/Legends|color]] and fashion symbolism to express their support or opposition to the Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] policies.<ref name="TPMV" /> The [[Education Advisor|Education Regent]] of Naboo [[Lufta Shif/Legends|Lufta Shif]] wore gentle and flowing teaching robes, reflecting the belief that learning was best encouraged by inspiration rather brute force or threat.<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|LUF 1-2|Lufta Shif}}</ref> The Queen herself wore clothes that made her look taller and larger through the use of wide shoulders and massive headpieces.<ref name="TPMV" /> In fact, the use of Naboo royal costume was highly codified and one of the most intricate in the galaxy.<ref name="FF104">{{FactFile|104|GAR 7-8|Garments and Couture}}</ref> High-ranking bureaucrats or politicians who employed refined fashion were sometimes derisively labeled "stuffed shirts."<ref name="A Summer's Dream">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref> Around the time of the Invasion, men often wore coats made of basketweave-like heavy fabric with typical Naboo-style bloused sleeves.<ref name="TPMV" />

The wealthy citizens of Naboo sometimes wore embroidered [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] ornated with Futhork calligraphy.<ref name="DP" /> In the same vein, some [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] of the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] like [[Simon Jabesq]] would label their duty [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with their name in Futhork letters.<ref name="TPMV" />

===Design===
[[File:Naboo_jewellery.png|thumb|Naboo jewellery]]
In Naboo design, aesthetics were prioritized over utility,<ref name="TPMV" /> and handcrafted, elegant shapes were given preference.<ref name="crossI" /> A fine example of the Naboo style was the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]],<ref name="TPMV" /> a diplomatic vessel<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> that showcased artful contours and a mirroring silver [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]] finish,<ref name="TPMV" /> fully hand-polished by artisans.<ref name="nubianDB">{{DB|starship|nabooroyalstarship|Naboo Royal (Queen's) Starship}}</ref>

==Science, technology and education==
Under Queen Amidala's rule, professor [[Lufta Shif/Legends|Lufta Shif]] held the post of [[Education Advisor|Education Regent]] in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]].<ref name="shif">{{DB|character|luftashif|Shif, Lufta}}</ref> Theed was home to a institutions of learning such as Theed University,<ref name="DP" /> the [[Royal Academy/Legends|Royal Academy]],<ref name="inside" /> the [[Theed Royal Library]],<ref name="JPB-PG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> the [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]],<ref name="adventure game">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref><ref name="predators">{{GamerCite|2|The Predators}}</ref> the [[Theed School of Technology and Engineering]]<ref name="Ionosphere">{{GamerCite|1|Peril in the Ionosphere}}</ref> and at least one [[Theed private school|private school]].<ref name="minnau-db">{{DB|character|teckla|Minnau, Teckla}}</ref> The city of Keren also maintained a municipal [[Government Education Center]] inside its [[City Government Complex]].<ref name="SoN" />

Among important science and technology companies from the planet were [[Plasma Energy Engineering/Legends|Plasma Energy Engineering]],<ref name="DP" /> [[Naboo Technologies/Legends|Naboo Technologies]],<ref name="AnEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> [[Theed Arms/Legends|Theed Arms]],<ref name="SoN" /> [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]],<ref name="NEGVV" /> the [[Royal Engineers]]<ref name="TPMV" /> and the Gungan [[BullbaBong]].<ref name="bulbabong">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010322c_shuttle&c=rpg|text=BullbaBong BB-2 Shuttle}}</ref>

==Media==
{{Quote|You couldn't turn around without seeing her face on the news or a holoset. The media loved her—they called her 'the Herald of a New Age.'|Ian Lago referring to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="A Summer's Dream" />}}
The ''[[Naboo Herald]]'' was a notable news publication from the planet.<ref name="SWG" /> [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Ista Kezever]] was a known collaborator by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], publishing the article "Galaxy in Review ... Intergalactic Report 12.1" about changes in politics and technology.<ref name="loading">As seen on the loading screen of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during Publish 12.1 in [[January]] [[2005]].</ref> During Veruna's reign, politician Padmé Amidala was beloved by media outlets on the planet, nicknaming the Princess of Theed the "Herald of the New Age."<ref name="A Summer's Dream" />

==Politics==
===Law===
{{Quote|You could use this incident as a means of emancipating yourself.''"<br />"''Naboo doesn't honor that practice. I'm in his sway until I'm twenty-one years old.|Hego Damask and Palpatine|<ref name="DP" />}}
Under Naboo law, the scent of [[Millaflower/Legends|millaflowers]] for therapeutic use could only be extracted and sold by licensed drug manufacturers.<ref name="FF121">{{FactFile|121|NAB 49-50|Naboo &ndash; Millaflowers}}</ref>

For Naboo judges, the murder of a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] officer was a most serious crime, only one step below assassinating the monarch.<ref name="monster" />

Despite the Naboo belief that biological age mattered little, the full [[Age of responsibility|legal adulthood]] among them was set at twenty-one,<ref name="DP" /> as opposed to a younger seventeen on both [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and Alderaan.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> Additionally, a youth could not be freed from the influence of a parent or guardian before reaching that age.<ref name="DP" />

==Social conventions==
During funeral rites, grandmothers would usually dress the body of their grandchild and prepare it for the "last journey."<ref name="LotJ:DoN" />

Bouquets of odorous millaflowers were popular gifts among the Naboo since ancient times. In fact, the gift of millaflowers had acquired a deep significance, which is why that practice was part of many meeting rituals, both on public occasions or on private encounters. By offering such a bouquet the giver would signify that he or she was pleased to be in the recipient's company. By accepting them, the recipient would express his or her trust toward the giver.<ref name="FF121" />

==Festivities and holidays==
[[File:Theed_youth_freedom.png|thumb|250px||The children of Naboo celebrate the victory over the Trade Federation.]]
{{Quote|Eight hundred and seventy years ago, Naboo joined the Republic. And tonight, we celebrate that union!|Palpatine opening the Festival of Light|<ref name="CoN" />}}
The planet traditionally celebrated the anniversary of its adhesion to the Galactic Republic in a festivity known as the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]].<ref name="CoN" /> Theed also hosted the annual [[Theed Festival of the Arts]] during the Galactic Civil War, where it showcased the work of some of Naboo's most prominent artists.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="LEI9-10">{{FactFile|109|LEI 9-10|Leisure}}</ref> At that time, the city of Moenia was one of the hosts of the annual [[Galactic Moon Festival]], an event with eerie and ghoulish themes. It was organized by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and it saw regular participation of citizens and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], who dressed up in costumes handpicked by Jabba.<ref name="returnGMF">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68475&month=102009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; The Return of the Galactic Moon Festival}}</ref> The seaside town of [[Kaadara]] was also chosen the host of the second [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]], held annually.<ref name="SWG" />

The Naboo also gathered to celebrate naturally occuring events, such as the blooming of a [[Unidentified pink flower|pink flower]] that blossomed once every eighty-eight years<ref name="TPMV" /> and the springtime [[Festival of Glad Arrival/Legends|festival of Glad Arrival]], held by the [[Pastoral Collective/Legends|Pastoral Collective]] in Lake Retreat.<ref name="ITWSW:AOTC" />
